options.content:
> **Derived presentation view.** Grafana is not evidence authority. The importer verifies the sealed bundle first. Use the provenance table to locate its checksum manifest. Missing evidence stays **MISSING**.

`INTERFACE authenticated HTTP admission` → `DURABLE PostgreSQL authority + outbox` → `RUNTIME relay` → `DURABLE ordered Pub/Sub subscription` → `RUNTIME six fixed StreamingPull workers` → `DURABLE ThreadEvents` → `INTERFACE authenticated cursor SSE`

Pressure is owned by PostgreSQL admission in the current failing run.

panels.title: Retained and rejected decisions
panels.description: A retained decision is not the same as full production qualification.

options.content:
| Step | Change | Evidence-backed decision |
|---|---|---|
| Direct PostgreSQL | No atomic broker handoff | Rejected, dual-write stranded and ghost work |
| Push | Authenticated Cloud Run push | Rejected, cold-start delivery tail |
| Corrected push | Durable publication ownership | Correctness retained, combined-load tail remained |
| Sharded push | More subscriptions | Rejected, complexity without user-visible SLO win |
| Durable activation | Second Pub/Sub hop | Rejected, extra authority and recovery surface |
| Fixed StreamingPull | One ordered subscription, fixed warm fleet | Selected for predictable delivery and recovery reserve |
